exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.setup: Lie on your back. Bend your knees with the soles of your feet on the floor, hip-width apart. Arms by your sides, palms on the floor.
steps: Squeeze your glutes and lift your hips off the floor; form a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Hold for a moment at the top, keeping your glutes tight.
Lower your hips slowly to the floor.
exercises.tip: As you rise, also gently lift your pelvic floor muscle.
exercises.mistake: Don't overarch your lower back; don't lift your hips higher than your shoulders.

exercises.name: Pelvic Tilt
exercises.setup: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet on the floor. There's a small gap between your lower back and the floor.
steps: Gently draw your belly in and press your lower back into the floor; close the gap.
Your pelvis tilts slightly upwards; your hips don't lift off the floor.
Release and let the gap return.
exercises.tip: The movement is very small; only your pelvis rocks.
exercises.mistake: Don't lift your hips off the floor or hold your breath.

exercises.name: Pillow Squeeze
exercises.setup: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet on the floor. Put a pillow or a folded towel between your knees.
steps: Squeeze the pillow inwards with your knees.
As you squeeze, also lift your pelvic floor muscle.
Relax slowly; don't let the pillow drop.
exercises.tip: Breathe out as you squeeze and in as you relax.
exercises.mistake: Don't lift your hips or lower back; only your knees squeeze inwards.

exercises.name: Clamshell
exercises.setup: Lie on your side with your head on your lower arm. Bend your knees forward, feet and knees stacked.
steps: Keeping your feet together, open your top knee upwards.
Pause briefly at the top without rolling your hips back.
Close your knee slowly.
exercises.tip: Halfway through, the screen tells you: switch to the other side.
exercises.mistake: Don't roll your hips back; your lower back and hips stay still, only the knee opens.

exercises.name: Knee-to-Chest Stretch
exercises.setup: Lie on your back, knees bent.
steps: Pull both knees towards your chest and hug them with your arms.
Stay where you are as you breathe in.
As you breathe out, bring your knees a little closer and let your lower back relax.
exercises.tip: Keep your head and shoulders on the floor; breathe easily.
exercises.mistake: Don't force your knees in; the stretch should be gentle and pain-free.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.target: Deep abdominal muscles and core stability
exercises.setup: Lie on your back. Reach your arms to the ceiling and lift your knees into the air, bent at 90 degrees (tabletop position).
steps: Slowly extend one arm behind your head and the opposite leg forward.
Reach as far as you can without lifting your lower back off the floor.
Bring the arm and leg back to the start.
exercises.tip: Halfway through, switch to the other arm and leg.
exercises.mistake: If your lower back lifts, extend your leg less.

exercises.name: Squat
exercises.setup: Stand up, feet shoulder-width apart, toes turned slightly out.
steps: Push your hips back as if sitting on a chair and lower down; reach your arms forward.
Go as low as is comfortable, keeping your chest up.
Push through your heels to stand up and squeeze your glutes.
exercises.tip: Breathe out as you stand up.
exercises.mistake: Don't let your knees cave in; keep them pointing the same way as your toes.

exercises.name: Sumo Squat
exercises.target: Inner thighs, glutes and pelvic floor
exercises.setup: Stand with your feet wide, toes pointing out. Bring your hands together at your chest.
steps: Keeping your body upright, open your knees out and lower down.
Keep your knees over your toes.
Squeeze your inner thighs and glutes as you stand up.
exercises.tip: As you stand up, also lift your pelvic floor muscle.
exercises.mistake: Don't lean forward; keep your body upright the whole time.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.setup: Lie face down. Put your elbows under your shoulders and lift your body onto your toes.
steps: Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Draw your belly in gently and hold the position.
Don't forget to breathe; hold until the time is up.
exercises.tip: If it's too hard, do it with your knees on the floor.
exercises.mistake: Don't let your hips drop or rise.

exercises.name: Bird-Dog
exercises.setup: Get on all fours: hands under your shoulders, knees under your hips.
steps: Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Pause briefly when your arm and leg are parallel to the floor.
Bring them back slowly.
exercises.tip: Halfway through, switch to the other arm and leg.
exercises.mistake: Don't let your lower back sag or your hips turn to the side.

exercises.name: Hip Opener Stretch
exercises.setup: Put one knee on the floor, the other foot in front with that knee bent at 90 degrees. Put your hands on your front knee.
steps: Keeping your body upright, slowly push your hips forward.
Feel the stretch at the front of the hip of your back leg.
Come back slowly.
exercises.mistake: Don't let your front knee go far past your toes; the stretch should be gentle.

exercises.name: Butterfly Stretch
exercises.setup: Sit on the floor, bring the soles of your feet together and hold your feet with your hands. Back upright.
steps: As you breathe in, straighten your back.
As you breathe out, let your knees drop towards the floor.
Without forcing, relax a little more with each breath.
exercises.tip: Don't push your knees down with your hands; let them drop under their own weight.
